reply.emotion: affectionate and warm, speaking softly to a pet
notes: In Mexico and other Spanish-speaking countries, 'gato' also refers to a mechanical car jack used when changing a flat tire.
Do not confuse 'gato' (cat) with 'gota' (drop of liquid) or 'gordo' (fat).

senses.definition: Mamífero pequeño, felino, doméstico, de pelo suave y cuatro patas, que suele maullar.

examples.text: El gato duerme en el sillón toda la tarde.
examples.translation: The cat sleeps on the armchair all afternoon.
examples.emotion: cozy and quiet, watching a pet rest peacefully

senses.definition: Herramienta mecánica que se usa para levantar vehículos pesados y poder cambiar una rueda.

examples.text: Necesitamos sacar el gato del maletero para cambiar la llanta.
examples.translation: We need to take the jack out of the trunk to change the tire.
examples.emotion: focused and slightly impatient by the roadside
